title: Cam Skattebo on Giants not adding a running back: They know what I can do

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Skattebo on Giants not adding a running back: They know what I can do
sources.description: Cam Skattebo is set to return to the Giants lineup for Thursday night's game against the Commanders and he won't be looking over his shoulder at any new additions to the team's running back depth chart.
